p.ds: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 49 B1 Scodra

A city of ancient Umbrian and Etruscan origin, Perusia aided Rome during the Second Punic War but was sieged and reduced by Octavian in the first century B.C. during campaigns against Lucius Antonius. It was rebuilt by Augustus and became Colonia Vibia Augusta Perusia quite late, in A.D. 251-3, under Trebonianus Gallus.
p.dh: Ősi umber és etruszk eredetű város; Perusia a második pun háborúban Rómát segítette, de a Kr. e. 1. században, a Lucius Antonius elleni hadjárat során Octavianus ostrommal bevette. Augustus újjáépítette, és meglehetősen későn, Kr. u. 251–253-ban, Trebonianus Gallus alatt Colonia Vibia Augusta Perusia lett.

p.ds: Erzurum is a modern city in eastern Turkey with antecedents at least as early as the Urartian period. In late Roman times, the settlement was known as Theodosiopolis. A medieval fortress (Erzurum Kale) occupies a prominent hill in the modern city center.
